header.name: Alternate Workcenter from Screen
header.description: Create/Update/Delete operations for Alternate Workcenters and associated Product Strategy Process

data.messageTransform: "No Product Strategy Process Found with ID: " & $state.context.REQUEST.productStrategyProcessId

data.query:
query StrategyProcess($where:ProductStrategyProcessWhereInput!){
  productStrategyProcess(where: $where) {
    edges {
      node {
        screenId
        workcenterId
            leadTime
        transitTimeAfter
        transitTimeBefore
        generatePurchaseOrder
        requireReceipt
        useSupplierLabel
        externalId
        useWorkcenterRates
        defaultDistribution
        unitPerCycle
        standardRate
        setupRate
        setupOperators
        setupOffalAllowed
        quotedRate
        productionOperators
        productionOffalAllowed
        minimumProductionRunTime
        idealRate
        cycleTime
      }
    }
  }
}

query AlternateWorkcenter($whereProcess:ProductStrategyProcessWhereInput!, $whereAlternateWorkcenter:AlternateWorkcenterWhereInput!){
  alternateWorkcenter(where: $whereAlternateWorkcenter) {
    edges {
      node {
        screenId
        workcenterId
        leadTime
        transitTimeAfter
        transitTimeBefore
        generatePurchaseOrder
        requireReceipt
        useSupplierLabel
        externalId
        useWorkcenterRates
        defaultDistribution
        unitPerCycle
        standardRate
        setupRate
        setupOperators
        setupOffalAllowed
        quotedRate
        productionOperators
        productionOffalAllowed
        minimumProductionRunTime
        idealRate
        cycleTime
        
      }
    }
  },
  productStrategyProcess(where: $whereProcess) {
    edges {
      node {
        screenId
        workcenterId
        leadTime
        transitTimeAfter
        transitTimeBefore
        generatePurchaseOrder
        requireReceipt
        useSupplierLabel
        externalId
        useWorkcenterRates
        defaultDistribution
        unitPerCycle
        standardRate
        setupRate
        setupOperators
        setupOffalAllowed
        quotedRate
        productionOperators
        productionOffalAllowed
        minimumProductionRunTime
        idealRate
        cycleTime
      }
    }
  }
}

data.messageTransform: "Failed to retrieve Alternate Workcenter or Product Strategy Process"
